value.rationale: The object is the precise failed-product-compatibility two-apex four-cube family singled out in the 2026 primary paper. A complete all-height Mahler profile answers its unresolved natural benchmark beyond the existing 12/7 lower certificate, and uncovers a real planar difference-body combinatorial phase transition and cusp in a four-dimensional volume product. This exact self-contained geometric invariant can be reused as a test family even without any general Mahler theorem. Novelty of the formula alone would not suffice absent this explicit motivating gap.
